text.en:
Creation and Composition. - There is hereby created a Special National
Public-Private Reconstruction Commission (Commission) appointed by the
President but headed by a business leader, with the Secretary of Finance and a
leader of the Church as co-chairs, and with department heads and business groups,
representatives of Philippine and international non-government organizations as
members. The Commission is hereby mandated to study the causes, costs and
actions to be taken in the wake of Typhoons Ondoy, Pepeng and Frank, and to seek
fresh aid to fund reconstruction in the aftermath of said typhoons.

Secretariat. - The National Economic and Development Authority and
the Office of Civil Defense shall form the Secretariat of the Commission.

Repealing Clause. - All Executive issuances inconsistent in whole or in
part with this Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE on this 12th day of October in the Year of Our Lord Two Thousand and Nine.
Marie A hugs
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
